banner.title: We're renewing Goteo!
banner.description: Goteo has built a unique history in the world of crowdfunding. Do you want to keep being part of it?

blog.title: Flip the script. Fund what matters!
blog.excerpt: We are living through overlapping emergencies: climate, housing, care, belonging. And too many ideas that could make a difference never find the support they need.  This space is for them. And for you. Inspired by the New European Bauhaus, it supports projects that respond, repair, and reimagine how we live together. From the Mediterranean and beyond.

matchfunding.title: Matchfunding
matchfunding.description: You'll only see the match effect on Goteo. Since 2013, we have been looking for organizations that want to multiply the impact of crowdfunding. For every euro a person contributes to a Goteo campaign, a collaborating institution (foundation, public administration, company…) contributes the same amount, or even more.

impact.title: Impact Data
impact.description: Matchfunding not only multiplies economic resources but also generates tangible social impact. Essentially, matchfunding transforms micro-donations into macro impact, validating projects with citizen support and optimizing public/private resources.

hero.title: Discover how we do crowdfunding
hero.description: At Goteo, we believe that collective funding is more than money: it is trust, community, and social commitment. Our crowdfunding model is based on promoting projects that generate a positive impact and closely accompanying the people and organizations that make them possible.

whatIs.title: What is crowdfunding
whatIs.subtitle: A real social impact.
whatIs.description: Crowdfunding is a form of financing that brings together people who believe in an idea and decide to support it with small (or large) contributions. At Goteo, we understand it as a space not just to raise funds, but also to create support networks, visibility, and learning.

advisory.title: Support and guidance from our team
advisory.description: At Goteo, you are never alone. Our team guides you step-by-step, from defining your project to managing the campaign. We offer free advice to help you prepare your project. If you need more assistance, you can request premium personalized advisory, with support materials and a proven methodology to increase your chances of success.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.description: Define objectives, budget, duration, and communication plan. Your project can be published if it meets these criteria.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: We activate fundraising and support you in dissemination.

fundsReceived.title: Funds received
fundsReceived.description: Upon reaching the goal, complete a form and send documentation for the transfer. Ensure transparency and explain the project to the community.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.description: After the campaign, share the project's progress with your donor community and close the cycle with transparency.

events.title: Join our trainings and events
events.description: We periodically organize workshops, webinars, and gatherings where we share learnings, trends, and real crowdfunding experiences. These are spaces to train, inspire, and connect with others who, like you, want to turn ideas into realities. Subscribe to receive current information from our bulletin.

taxDeductions.title: Tax deductions
taxDeductions.description: Donations in Goteo have tax advantages for both individuals and companies, as we manage contributions through a foundation. This is something that most platforms do not offer.

allOrNothing.title: All or nothing
allOrNothing.description: Projects receive financial support only if they prove to be viable and reach the minimum budget. Otherwise, donations are returned to donors to continue supporting new initiatives.

twoRounds.title: Two rounds of co-financing in 40+40 days
twoRounds.description: By default, we establish two co-financing rounds, each 40 days long. The first is "all or nothing," tied to the essential minimum budget, and the second to an optimal amount for making additional improvements, where everything is included.

personalizedSupport.title: Personalized support
personalizedSupport.description: We don't leave promoters alone. Our team advises before, during, and after the campaign with strategic advice and technical support. Other platforms only serve as a showcase for projects.

loyalCommunity.title: Loyal community
loyalCommunity.description: We have a base of recurring donors who trust Goteo and continue to support campaigns because they value the social and cultural impact. This provides projects with more opportunities to achieve their goals.

matchfunding.title: Institutional co-financing (matchfunding)
matchfunding.description: Through alliances with institutions, we multiply citizen contributions with public or private funds. This hybrid model is unique to Goteo and does not exist on most platforms.

socialImpact.title: Focus on transformative social impact
socialImpact.description: Not all projects are accepted. At Goteo, we prioritize those aligned with the Social Economy and democratic values, be it in the form of open knowledge, community improvements, or environmental and social impact.

transparency.title: Transparency and trust
transparency.description: Campaigns are subjected to a validation and advisory process. The community knows that the published projects meet minimum quality and coherence standards, which increases credibility.

provenMethodology.title: Proven methodology
provenMethodology.description: With over a decade of experience and hundreds of funded projects, we offer a proven methodology that increases chances of success.
